items.direction: Keep the exterior camera in the same place or use a very slow restrained move. Harper approaches along the gantry and stops one or two paces before the entrance, still outside. Keep the entry closed or visually opaque; no cabin reveal or threshold crossing.

Cut to a shoulders-up close-up looking screen right toward the ship. A quiet practical positive decision: yes, I think that will do. Relaxed brow and closed lips; no broad smile or excited performance. End on her decision, before boarding.
